policy: Respect SAP existing codes / T-codes / terms; VIA aligns to SSOT canonical only.

cost_behavior.variable_fixed_cost: Fixed total cost allocated per unit and therefore variable at unit level, e.g. depreciation per unit, fixed OH absorption.
cost_behavior.fixed_variable_cost: Variable purchase/cost in theory but committed in short term, e.g. MOQ, take-or-pay, long-term purchase commitment.
